summary: Testing BLOCKED: Frontend fails to compile due to CSS syntax error in /app/frontend/src/styles/Landing.css. Cannot verify mobile optimization fixes for Use Cases or 'Kako deluje' sections because the app cannot render — only a red 'Compiled with problems' error overlay shows.

failed.issue: PostCSS SyntaxError: 'Unclosed block' at Landing.css line 1545 — the @media (max-width: 768px) block opened at line 1545 is not properly closed (or an inner rule block is unclosed). File ends at line 2079 with a single '}'. Because of this, the entire React app fails to compile and shows the webpack error overlay instead of the landing page.
failed.evidence: Screenshot shows: 'Module build failed (from ./node_modules/postcss-loader/dist/cjs.js): SyntaxError (1545:1) /app/frontend/src/styles/Landing.css Unclosed block'. Playwright could not locate .use-cases-grid-v2 or .seo-steps-grid on any viewport (390px / 768px / 1920px).

action_items: Fix unclosed block in /app/frontend/src/styles/Landing.css starting at line 1545. Likely a missing '}' inside the newly-added mobile optimization rules (lines ~1805-1808 and 2054-2084 mentioned in review request). Recommend running 'stylelint' or a CSS brace-balance check on the file.

After fixing the compile error, re-run mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1080) tests to verify: (1) Use Cases shows 1 col on mobile / 3 cols on desktop, (2) 'Kako deluje' shows 1 col on mobile / 4 cols on desktop, (3) step arrows hidden on mobile, (4) no horizontal overflow.
